provider_contributions.audible_catalog: Audiobook catalogue records: narrator, series, runtime and publication detail.
provider_contributions.audiosilo: Audiobook runtime and chapter structure that can corroborate a recording.
provider_contributions.audnexus: Audiobook chapter listings and narrator credits.
provider_contributions.google_books: Publisher descriptions, categories and page counts for books.
provider_contributions.hardcover: Community book records with series, edition and contributor detail.
provider_contributions.inventaire: Work identity, editions and cover images for books.
provider_contributions.itunes_search: Checks an ebook's title and author against iTunes audiobook listings; audiobooks are never sent to it.
provider_contributions.open_library: Book editions, ISBNs, publication dates and cover images.
